definitions.explanation: The place someone is heading to or planning to go.
Where someone has gone or can be found.

examples.japanese: {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めていない→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I haven't decided on a destination.

examples.japanese: {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧{行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I got in a taxi and told the driver my destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know where he went.

examples.japanese: {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らせて→知らせる：01208_shiraseru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かけて→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Let us know where you're going before you head out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かって→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was worried because I didn't know where my daughter had gone, but I was relieved to find out she was at a friend's house.

notes:
{行|ゆ}き{先|さき} has two related meanings: the destination someone is heading to, and the whereabouts of someone who has left.

ETYMOLOGY:
Compound of ⟦{行|ゆ}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (ahead, destination).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: decide on a destination
- {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らせる→知らせる：01208_shiraseru⟧: inform someone of one's whereabouts
- {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: don't know where someone went
- {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げる→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧: state one's destination

SIMILAR TERMS:
- ⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧: destination — more formal, emphasizes the intended goal
- ⟦{行方|ゆくえ}→行方：04082_yukue⟧: whereabouts — often used when someone is missing or lost
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り{先|さき}→帰り先：28308_kaerisaki⟧: return destination, where one is going back to
